limits: All use operator maintenance authority. Even plan GET records a maintenance audit through a write UoW; it was not called in this read-only task.
Plan refuses while owner._stopping or selected session is in owner.sessions. It describes outstanding owned slots only; it is not necessary for already retired history.

Plan validates exact scope/opening/binding/claim and requires opening connection generation lower than replacement owner. Confirm recomputes exact plan, rejects empty/stale and records operator attestation before slot release.
Confirm is not OS proof, not an override of old live owner and not replay authority. It cannot synthesize a missing stream or historical release proof.
